recent_en: GIIB reported a quarterly net loss of RM23.84 million on November 26, 2026, mainly due to a RM15.05 million impairment. Earlier, the company received a UMA query from the exchange and a trading reminder amid unusual share price movements in late October to early November. In September, it issued 19.08 million new shares from warrant conversion.
notable_en: On September 4, 2026, the company issued 19.08 million new shares from warrant conversion at RM0.42 per share, listed on September 7.
On November 26, 2026, the company announced quarterly results with a net loss of RM23.84 million and no dividend.
On November 24, 2026, the company announced a material litigation.
risks_en: The company received a UMA query from the exchange on October 29 and 30, 2026, due to unusual share price movements.
The company received a trading reminder on November 10, 2026.
The company announced a material litigation on November 24, 2026.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended December 31, 2025, revenue was RM10.205 million with a net loss of RM3.958 million, a net loss margin of 38.8%, narrower than the previous quarter's 69.0%; revenue grew 82.3% quarter-on-quarter.
